en.headline: PolyU aims for 50-50 overseas to mainland student ratio among non-locals
en.dek: President Teng Jin-guang said the university enrolled about 1,000 non-local students this year at a 40-60 split and plans new hostels to support greater internationalisation.
body: Hong Kong Polytechnic University president Teng Jin-guang said the university aims to raise the ratio of overseas to mainland Chinese students among its non-local intake from the current 40:60 to 50:50 to strengthen internationalisation.

PolyU enrolled about 1,000 non-local students this year, of whom roughly 600 were from mainland China and 400 from other countries and regions. Teng described the result as satisfactory but set the next target at an even split. The move aligns with the city’s first five-year plan, which targets 100,000 non-local students in full-time post-secondary programmes by 2029/30; about 80,000 were enrolled in 2024/25.

Limited hostel places remain a constraint. PolyU currently has some 4,000 hostel places and guarantees one-year residence for all non-local undergraduates, which limits further expansion. Teng said a new hostel in Kowloon Tong is expected to be completed in 2028, with another in Ho Man Tin later, which should ease the bottleneck.

PolyU recently entered the world’s top 50 in the QS World University Rankings 2027 for the first time. Teng said scholarships remain an important tool for attracting top students from less developed economies, and that Southeast Asia is among the target regions, though the university faces competition from institutions in Singapore and on the mainland.

zh.headline: 理大目標非本地生海外與內地比例達五五分
zh.dek: 校長滕錦光表示，今年取錄約1000名非本地生，海外與內地生約四六分，並計劃興建新宿舍支援國際化。
body: 香港理工大學校長滕錦光表示，校方目標將非本地生中海外學生與內地學生的比例，由現時約四比六提升至五比五，以加強國際化。
理大今年取錄約1000名非本地生，其中約600人來自內地，400人來自其他國家及地區。滕錦光形容成績不錯，下一步目標是一半一半。此舉配合本港首個五年計劃，目標在2029/30學年前吸納10萬名全日制高等教育非本地生；2024/25學年約有8萬人。
宿位不足仍是限制。理大目前約有4000個宿位，並保證所有非本地本科生可獲一年住宿，這限制了進一步擴招。滕錦光表示，九龍塘新宿舍預計2028年落成，何文田另一座稍後完成，應可紓緩瓶頸。
理大最近首次進入QS世界大學排名2027年全球首50名。滕錦光指出，獎學金仍是吸引經濟較落後地區尖子的重要手段，東南亞是目標來源地之一，但校方需面對新加坡及內地院校競爭。
